newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras August inflation 2.8 pct - govt.
newsitem.headline: Honduras August inflation 2.8 pct - govt.

text.p: Honduran consumer price inflation was 2.8 percent in August, up from 2.3 percent in July, the central bank said on Thursday.
The increase took accumulated inflation in the first eight months of the year to 17.9 percent, well above the government target of 16 percent for the whole year.
Inflation in the first eight months of last year was 18.5 percent. Year-on-year inflation in the 12 months through August 1996 was 24.3 percent, the central bank said.
A central bank official, who declined to be named, said inflation was likely to be higher than 21 percent by the end of the year. Inflation in 1995 was 26.8 percent.
